//: The machine-checkable half of docs/limitations.md's '## Known divergences' section (chtypes#185). The prose is authored there; this file carries only what the retired v0 checker could drive against loaded artifacts. Every '###' heading under that section must have exactly one entry here (by 'heading', matched verbatim, prefix stripped) and every entry here must match a heading — the retired v0 checker's coverage rule required either side to exist only with the other. Each check's 'settings' are a compile-time profile (a type gate binds at compile, docs/guides/settings.md 'The one exception'); 'err_code' and 'err_msg' are asserted only where docs/limitations.md itself states them — a code without a quoted message means the page named the code alone. 'stored' asserts THIS LIBRARY's current answer for a row's stored text (BatchResult.rows[i].values[column].text) — it is expected to start FAILING the day a relink makes the library match the server, which is the retirement signal for that entry, not a regression. 'stored_same' asserts that several named rows all store IDENTICAL text for a column, with no fixed text of its own — the shape a value computed once (rather than per row or per insert) produces, for a value (a random DEFAULT's exact bytes) that is not reproducible across processes. A check's top-level 'batches' (default 1) drives its payload through its compiled schema that many times, concatenating rows across calls in order, to reproduce separate INSERTs rather than one larger one. A check naming a top-level 'filter' (a boolean SQL expression) is driven down a DIFFERENT call tree: the schema compiles, the filter compiles over it, then Filter.rows(format, payload) answers one Verdict per row ('t'/'f'/'e'/'d') rather than an Outcome — its 'expect' still names 'outcome' (the call-level FilterOutcome, 'ok' unless the call itself was refused) and may also name 'verdicts' (the per-row list, index-aligned with the payload's rows, asserting THIS LIBRARY's current per-row answer exactly as 'stored' asserts a stored value — expected to start FAILING the day a relink makes the library refuse the query instead, the retirement signal for that entry). A check's 'lines' may be narrower than every served line a divergence is measured on: it names the lines THIS CHECK drives, which — like the demangle entry above — is the set where a library fix is expected to land and retire the entry; docs/limitations.md states the full measured scope in prose.

entries.heading: The row preview skips the engine's insert-time merge step on Collapsing and Replacing-with-`is_deleted` tables
entries.note: no machine check is expressible in this register's schema: a check drives one call tree (compile a schema, then a payload through the batch, or a filter through Filter.rows) and asserts that call's own outcome, so it cannot express the differential here, which is the row preview accepting a row that the batch preview refuses with 117. The schema has no field that selects the row preview (chs_preview_row) rather than the batch preview, and no 'expect' that contrasts two calls' outcomes. The v1 replacement of the checker must add both before this entry can carry a check. Retirement: on the artifact producer's measured re-run against the production library build that ships the fix, never on CI.

entries.heading: Creating a schema accepts MergeTree-family CREATE statements that a real server refuses
entries.note: no machine check is expressible in this register's schema: a check drives a payload through a schema that compiled, and asserts that call's outcome, while these cases are decided at schema creation, which a check cannot assert is refused or accepted as the differential. The v1 replacement of the checker must add an expectation on the schema-create call's own outcome before this entry can carry a check. Retirement: on the artifact producer's measured re-run against the production library build that ships the fix, never on CI.

entries.heading: A DEFAULT that throws on a row which supplies the column can fail the server's INSERT while this library accepts it
entries.note: no machine check is expressible in this register's schema: the case is driven with input_format_defaults_for_omitted_fields=1, a per-call setting whose compile-time profile this register's 'settings' can carry, but the measurement is on linux-amd64 only and this register cannot scope a check to a platform, and the retirement signal must come from the artifact producer's re-run against a real server. Retirement: on the artifact producer's measured re-run against the production library build that ships the fix, never on CI.

entries.heading: A clock-reading MATERIALIZED expression reports 1970 in a batch preview when no row omits a Volatile DEFAULT column
entries.note: no machine check is expressible in this register's schema: the divergence is in the batch document's 'computed' values and depends on the clock instant, which a check can neither read ('stored' asserts a stored column's text, not a computed value) nor pin together with chtypes_clock_offset_nanos. The v1 replacement of the checker must add an assertion on computed values under a pinned clock before this entry can carry a check. Retirement: on the artifact producer's measured re-run against the production library build that ships the fix, never on CI.
